class Solution:
    def countSubarrays(self, v: List[int], k: int) -> int:

        s = set()
        n = len(v)
        ans = 0

        mp = {}

        for i in range(n):
            q = set()

            q.add(v[i])
            if v[i] == k:
                ans += 1
            new_mp = {}
            new_mp[v[i]] = new_mp.get(v[i], 0) + 1

            for z in s:
                new_and = z & v[i]
                q.add(new_and)
                new_mp[new_and] = new_mp.get(new_and, 0) + mp.get(z, 0)
                if new_and == k:
                    ans += mp.get(z, 0)

            mp = new_mp
            s = q

        return ans

class Solution:
    def numberOfAlternatingGroups(self, colors: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        colors = colors + colors[:k-1]
        n = len(colors)
        odd = [0] * (n+1)
        even = [0] * (n+1)
        for i in range(n):
            if i%2== 0:
                even[i+1] = even[i] + colors[i]
                odd[i+1] = odd[i]
            else:            
                odd[i+1] = odd[i] + colors[i]
                even[i+1] = even[i]
        
        res = 0
        for i in range(n-k+1):
            j = i+k-1
            ei = (k // 2) + (1 if i%2 == 0 and k%2 == 1 else 0)
            oi = (k // 2 )+ (1 if i%2 == 1 and k%2 == 1 else 0)
            
            os = odd[j+1] - odd[i]
            es = even[j+1] - even[i]
            if os == 0 and es == ei:
                res += 1
            elif os == oi and es == 0:
                res += 1
        return res

class Solution:
    def numberOfAlternatingGroups(self, colors: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        numFound = 0
        i = 0
        j = 1
        n = len(colors)
        
        while j < n + k and i < n:
            tempJ = j
            tempEnd = tempJ % n
            
            # Find the end of the current alternating group
            while colors[tempEnd] != colors[(tempEnd - 1 + n) % n] and tempJ < n + k - 1:
                tempJ += 1
                tempEnd = tempJ % n
            
            # Calculate the number of groups found
            numFound += max(tempJ - i - k + 1, 0)
            i = tempJ
            j = i + 1
        
        return numFound

class Solution:
    def numberOfAlternatingGroups(self, colors: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        ind0 = 0
        ind1 = 1
        c = 0
        while ind0 < len(colors) and ind1 < len(colors) + k:
            ind = ind1 % len(colors)
            while colors[ind] != colors[ind - 1] and (ind1 < (len(colors) + k - 1)):
                ind1 += 1
                ind = ind1 % len(colors)
            c += max(ind1 - ind0 - k + 1, 0)
            ind0 = ind1
            ind1 = ind0 + 1
        return c
